intent: Place mandate cards at matching positions with different contents. Factual investigation and thesis-driven adaptation can be compared without becoming equivalent assignments.
source:
**Frame:** Left carries an independent-investigation mandate and must answer scoped factual questions. Right carries an adaptation brief and a thesis it wants to test.

**Caption:**
> ONE ANSWERS SCOPED QUESTIONS UNDER A MANDATE.
>
> ONE IS TESTING A THESIS IT ALREADY HAS.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `reconstructed` — roles stated accurately.
title: Investigation and adaptation have different mandates
